verses.geez: ወይእዜሰ፡ ትሑታን፡ ይስሕቁኒ፡ ዮምሰ፡ ባሕቲቶሙ፡ ይምዕዱኒ፡ እለ፡ መነንክዎሙ፡ ለአበዎሆሙ፡ ወእለ፡ ኢሐሰብክዎሙ፡ ወኢከመ፡ ከለባተ፡ መራዕይየ።
verses.translation: But now the youngest have laughed me to scorn, now they reprove me in their turn, whose fathers I set at nought; whom I did not deem worthy to be with my shepherd dogs.

translations.lxx: But now the youngest have laughed me to scorn, now they reprove me in their turn, whose fathers I set at nought; whom I did not deem worthy to be with my shepherd dogs.
translations.kjv: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
translations.ron: Iar acum am ajuns de batjocură pentru cei mai tineri decât mine şi pe ai căror părinţi îi preţuiam prea puţin, ca să-i pun alături cu câinii turmelor mele.
translations.grk: Νυνὶ δὲ κατεγέλασάν μου ἐλάχιστοι, νῦν νουθετοῦσί με ἐν μέρει, ὧν ἐξουδένουν τοὺς πατέρας αὐτῶν, οὓς οὐχ ἡγησάμην ἀξίους κυνῶν τῶν ἐμῶν νομάδων.

verses.geez: ወለምንት፡ ሊተ፡ ኀይለ፡ እዴሆሙ፡ ወይምጻእ፡ ሞት፡ ላዕሌሆሙ።
verses.translation: Yea, why had I the strength of their hands? for them the full term of life was lost.

translations.lxx: Yea, why had I the strength of their hands? for them the full term of life was lost.
translations.kjv: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
translations.ron: Ce aş fi făcut cu puterea braţelor lor, odată ce vlaga lor se dusese toată?
translations.grk: Καί γε ἰσχὺς χειρῶν αὐτῶν ἱνατί μοι; ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς ἀπώλετο συντέλεια.

verses.geez: ወያስተፍእሙ፡ እምረኃብ፡ እንዘ፡ ይልሕሱ፡ እለ፡ ያመስጡ፡ እምእደ፡ በድው፡ ትማልማ፡ በሥራኅ፡ ወበኃሣር።
verses.translation: One is childless in want and famine, such as they that fled but lately the distress and misery of drought.

translations.lxx: One is childless in want and famine, such as they that fled but lately the distress and misery of drought.
translations.kjv: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
translations.ron: Din pricina sărăciei şi a foametei înspăimântătoare, ei mânţcau rădăcini din locuri uscate şi mama lor era câmpia pustie şi jalnică.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἐνδείᾳ καὶ λιμῷ ἄγονος, οἱ φεύγοντες ἄνυδρον ἐχθὲς συνοχὴν καὶ ταλαιπωρίαν.

verses.geez: እለ፡ ይዋሕዩ፡ ወይሰእሉ፡ ወያስተፍእሙ፡ እለ፡ በተታሕሎ፡ የሐይዉ፡ ኅሡራን፡ ወዓማፅያን፡ ወዕኑሳን፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሠናያት፡ እለ፡ ሥርወ፡ ዕፅ፡ ይሜዕሩ፡ እምዐቢይ፡ ረኃብ።
verses.translation: Who compass the salt places on the sounding shore, who had salt herbs for their food, and were dishonourable and of no repute, in want of every good thing; who also ate roots of trees by reason of great hunger.

translations.lxx: Who compass the salt places on the sounding shore, who had salt herbs for their food, and were dishonourable and of no repute, in want of every good thing; who also ate roots of trees by reason of great hunger.
translations.kjv: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
translations.ron: Ei culegeau ierburi de prin mărăcini şi pâinea lor era rădăcina de ienupăr.
translations.grk: Οἱ περικυκλοῦντες ἄλιμα ἐπὶ ἠχοῦντι, οἵτινες ἄλιμα ἦν αὐτῶν τὰ σῖτα, ἄτιμοι δὲ καὶ πεφαυλισμένοι, ἐνδεεῖς παντὸς ἀγαθοῦ, οἳ καὶ ῥὶζας ξύλων ἐμασσῶντο ὑπὸ λιμοῦ μεγάλου.

verses.geez: ተንሥኡ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ሰረቅት፡ እለ፡ አብያቲሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ግበበ፡ ኰኵሕ።
verses.translation: Thieves have risen up against me,

translations.lxx: Thieves have risen up against me,
translations.kjv: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)
translations.ron: Erau goniţi din mijlocul oamenilor şi după ei lumea urla ca după nişte hoţi.
translations.grk: Ἐπανέστησάν μοι κλέπται,

verses.geez: ወይዌውዑ፡ ማእከለ፡ መጽአሞ፡ ወይትኃኡ፡ ውስተ፡ ሣዕረ፡ ገዳም።
verses.translation: whose houses were the caves of the rocks, who lived under the wild shrubs.

translations.lxx: whose houses were the caves of the rocks, who lived under the wild shrubs.
translations.kjv: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
translations.ron: Drept aceea, au ajuns să se aciueze pe marginea şuvoaielor, prin găurile pământului şi prin văgăunile stâncilor.
translations.grk: ὧν οἱ οἶκοι αὐτῶν ἦσαν τρῶγλαι πετρῶν·

verses.geez: ዓብድ፡ ውሉድ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ስም፡ እስመ፡ ጥፉአን፡ እምድር፡ ወጥበብ፡ እንተ፡ ጠፍአት፡ እምድር።
verses.translation: They will cry out among the rustling bushes.

translations.lxx: They will cry out among the rustling bushes.
translations.kjv: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
translations.ron: Zbiară prin hăţişuri, stau grămadă pe sub scaieţi.
translations.grk: Ἀναμέσον εὐήχων βοήσονται οἳ ὑπὸ φρύγανα ἄγρια διῃτῶντο.

verses.geez: ወይእዜሰ፡ መሰንቆ፡ ኮንክዎሙ፡ ወአነ፡ መኃድምቶሙ።
verses.translation: They are sons of fools and vile men, whose name and glory are quenched from off the earth.

translations.lxx: They are sons of fools and vile men, whose name and glory are quenched from off the earth.
translations.kjv: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
translations.ron: Neam de oameni ticăloşi, neam de oameni fără nume, ei erau gunoaiele pe care le arunci din ţară!
translations.grk: Ἀφρόνων υἱοὶ καὶ ἀτίμων, ὄνομα καὶ κλέος ἐσβεσμένον ἀπὸ γῆς.

verses.geez: ወያስቈርሩኒ፡ ወይርኅቁ፡ እምኔየ፡ ወኢይትሀከዩ፡ ወሪቀምራቅ፡ ውሰተ፡ ገጽየ።
verses.translation: But now I am their music, and they have me for a by-word.

translations.lxx: But now I am their music, and they have me for a by-word.
translations.kjv: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
translations.ron: şi astăzi, iată că sunt cântecul lor, am ajuns basmul lor.
translations.grk: Νυνὶ δὲ κιθάρα ἐγώ εἰμι αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐμὲ θρύλλημα ἔχουσιν.

verses.geez: ወከሠተ፡ ምጕንጳሁ፡ ወቀተለኒ፡ ወፈነወልጓመ፡ ውስተ፡ ገጽየ፡ ኃያል።
verses.translation: And they stood aloof and abhorred me, and spared not to spit in my face.

translations.lxx: And they stood aloof and abhorred me, and spared not to spit in my face.
translations.kjv: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
translations.ron: Le e groază de mine, s-au depărtat de mine şi pentru obrazul meu n-au făcut economie cu scuipatul lor!
translations.grk: Ἐβδελύξαντο δέ με ἀποστάντες μακρὰν, ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ προσώπου μου οὐκ ἐφείσαντο πτύελον.

verses.geez: ወተንሥአ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ በየማነ፡ ኃይል፡ ወሰፍሐ፡ እገሩሁ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ወገብረ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ሞት፡ ላዕሌየ።
verses.translation: For he has opened his quiver and afflicted me: they also have cast off the restraint of my presence.

translations.lxx: For he has opened his quiver and afflicted me: they also have cast off the restraint of my presence.
translations.kjv: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
translations.ron: Cel ce şi-a deznodat ştreangul robiei mă asupreşte şi tot aşa cel ce şi-a scos zăbalele din gură.
translations.grk: Ἀνοίξας γὰρ φαρέτραν αὐτοῦ ἐκάκωσέ με, καὶ χαλινὸν τοῦ προσώπου μου ἐξαπέστειλεν.

verses.geez: ወደምሰሰ፡ አሠርየ፡ ወሰለበኒ፡ አልባስየ፡ ወደጐፀኒ፡ በአሕፃሁ።
verses.translation: They have risen up against me on the right hand of their offspring; they have stretched out their foot, and directed against me the ways of their destruction.

translations.lxx: They have risen up against me on the right hand of their offspring; they have stretched out their foot, and directed against me the ways of their destruction.
translations.kjv: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
translations.ron: În dreapta mea se ridică martori potrivnici mie, în cursa lor au prins picioarele mele şi şi-au croit drumuri împotrivă-mi.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ δεξιῶν βλαστοῦ ἐπανέστησαν, πόδα αὐτῶν ἐξέτειναν, καὶ ὡδοποίησαν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ· τρίβους ἀπωλείας αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወረሰየኒ፡ ዘከመ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ወአአይስ፡ በሕማም።
verses.translation: My paths are ruined; for they have stripped off my raiment: he has shot at me with his weapons.

translations.lxx: My paths are ruined; for they have stripped off my raiment: he has shot at me with his weapons.
translations.kjv: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
translations.ron: Au dărâmat poteca mea, cu gând ca să mă piardă, ei se suie încoace şi nimeni nu le este stavilă.
translations.grk: Ἐξετρίβησαν τρίβοι μου, ἐξέδυσαν γάρ μου τὴν στολήν·

verses.geez: ውቱረ፡ ይዋህየኒ፡ ነጾራር፡ ወትፍሕቅ፡ ነፍስየ፡ በላዕሌየ፡ ወትልሕስ፡ ወኃለፈት፡ ሕይወትየ፡ ከመ፡ ደመና፡ ዘትነጽሕ።
verses.translation: And he has pleaded against me as he will: I am overwhelmed with pains.

translations.lxx: And he has pleaded against me as he will: I am overwhelmed with pains.
translations.kjv: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.
translations.ron: Ca printr-o spărtură largă, ei dau iureş şi în dărâmături se tăvălesc.
translations.grk: βέλεσιν αὐτοῦ κατηκόντισέ με. Κέκριται δέ μοι ὡς βούλεται, ἐν ὀδύναις πέφυρμαι.

verses.geez: ወይእዜሰ፡ ተክዕወት፡ ነፍስየ፡ በላዕሌየ፡ ወመልአ፡ በላዕሌየ፡ ፃዕር።
verses.translation: My pains return upon me; my hope is gone like the wind, and my safety as a cloud.

translations.lxx: My pains return upon me; my hope is gone like the wind, and my safety as a cloud.
translations.kjv: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
translations.ron: Mulţimea spaimelor s-a întors asupra mea, slava mea au gonit-o ca vântul şi izbăvirea mea a trecut ca un nor.
translations.grk: Ἐπιστρέφονταί μου αἱ ὀδύναι, ᾤχετό μου ἡ ἐλπὶς ὥσπερ πνεῦμα, καὶ ὥσπερ νέφος ἡ σωτηρία μου.

verses.geez: ወኵሎ፡ ሌሊተ፡ ይነድዱ፡ አፅዕምትየ፡ ወይትመሰዉ፡ አሥራውየ።
verses.translation: Even now my life shall be poured forth upon me; and days of anguish seize me.

translations.lxx: Even now my life shall be poured forth upon me; and days of anguish seize me.
translations.kjv: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
translations.ron: Şi acum sufletul meu se topeşte în mine, zile de amărăciune mă cuprind.
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἐκχυθήσεται ἡ ψυχή μου, ἔχουσιν δέ με ἡμέραι ὀδυνῶν.

verses.geez: እምዓቢይ፡ ኃይል፡ አትሜጠዎ፡ ለልብስየ፡ ወሐነቀኒ፡ አፈ፡ መልበስየ፡ ወኅባኔኒ፡ ፀፈረ፡ ውስተ፡ ክሣድየ።
verses.translation: And by night my bones are confounded; and my sinews are relaxed.

translations.lxx: And by night my bones are confounded; and my sinews are relaxed.
translations.kjv: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
translations.ron: Noaptea oasele mele sunt ca sfredelite şi nervii mei nu ştiu de odihnă.
translations.grk: Νυκτὶ δέ μου τὰ ὀστᾶ συγκέχυται, τὰ δὲ νεῦρά μου διαλέλυται.

verses.geez: ወኬዱኒ፡ ከመ፡ ፅቡር፡ መሬት፡ ወሐመድ፡ ኮኑ፡ መክፈልትየ።
verses.translation: With great force my disease has taken hold of my garment: it has compassed me as the collar of my coat.

translations.lxx: With great force my disease has taken hold of my garment: it has compassed me as the collar of my coat.
translations.kjv: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
translations.ron: Cu o putere năpraznică, Dumnezeu mă tine de haină şi mă strânge de gât ca gulerul cămăşii.
translations.grk: Ἐν πολλῇ ἰσχύϊ ἐπελάβετό μου τῆς στολῆς, ὥσπερ τὸ περιστόμιον τοῦ χιτῶνός μου περιέσχε με.

verses.geez: ገዓርኩ፡ ኀቤከ፡ ወኢሰማዕከኒ፡ ወቀዊምየ፡ ኢጠየቀኒ፡ ደበዩኒ፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ምሕረት፡ ወጸንዓተረ፡ እድ፡ እንተ፡ ቀሠፈተኒ።
verses.translation: And thou hast counted me as clay; my portion is in dust and ashes.

translations.lxx: And thou hast counted me as clay; my portion is in dust and ashes.
translations.kjv: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
translations.ron: Mi-a dat brânci în noroi şi am ajuns să fiu la fel cu praful şi cu cenuşa.
translations.grk: Ἥγησαι δέ με ἴσα πηλῷ, ἐν γῇ καὶ σποδῷ μου ἡ μερίς.

verses.geez: ኃደገኒ፡ ውስተ፡ ናእክ፡ ወአርኃቀኒ፡ እምሕይወትየ።
verses.translation: And I have cried to thee, but thou hearest me not: but they stood still, and observed me.

translations.lxx: And I have cried to thee, but thou hearest me not: but they stood still, and observed me.
translations.kjv: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.
translations.ron: Strig către Tine şi nu-mi răspunzi, stau în picioare şi Tu nu mă vezi.
translations.grk: Κέκραγα δὲ πρὸς σὲ καὶ οὐκ ἀκούεις μου, ἔστησαν δὲ καὶ κατενόησάν με.

verses.geez: አእምር፡ ከሰመ፡ ሞት፡ ይቀጠቅጠኒ፡ ወማኅደሩሰ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘሞተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: They attacked me also without mercy: thou hast scourged me with a strong hand.

translations.lxx: They attacked me also without mercy: thou hast scourged me with a strong hand.
translations.kjv: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
translations.ron: Tu Te-ai făcut asupritorul meu şi cu toată puterea braţului Tău mă prigoneşti.
translations.grk: Ἐπέβησαν δέ μοι ἀνελεημόνως, χειρὶ κραταιᾷ με ἐμαστίγωσας.

verses.geez: እምፈተውኩ፡ ለልየ፡ እትጐረአይ፡ ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ አስተበቊዕ፡ ባዕድ፡ ይግበር፡ ሊተ፡ ከማሁ።
verses.translation: And thou hast put me to grief, and hast cast me away from safety.

translations.lxx: And thou hast put me to grief, and hast cast me away from safety.
translations.kjv: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.
translations.ron: Tu mă ridici deasupra vântului şi mă pui pe el călare şi apoi mă nimiceşti cu iureşul furtunii.
translations.grk: Ἔταξας δέ με ἐν ὀδύναις, καὶ ἀπέῤῥιψάς με ἀπὸ σωτηρίας.

verses.geez: አንሰ፡ በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምንዱብ፡ እበኪ፡ ወአነብፅእመ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ሰብእ፡ ሕሙመ።
verses.translation: For I know that death will destroy me: for the earth is the house appointed for every mortal.

translations.lxx: For I know that death will destroy me: for the earth is the house appointed for every mortal.
translations.kjv: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.
translations.ron: Ştiu foarte bine că Tu mă duci spre moarte şi la locul de întâlnire al tuturor muritorilor.
translations.grk: Οἶδα γὰρ ὅτι θάνατός με ἐκτρίψει, οἰκία γὰρ παντὶ θνητῷ γῆ.

verses.geez: አንሰ፡ አጽናዕክዋ፡ ለሠናይት፡ ናሁ፡ ተራከባኒ፡ መዋዕል፡ እኩያት፡ ወተሰፎኩ፡ ብርሃነ፡ ወመጽአኒ፡ ጽልመት።
verses.translation: Oh then that I might lay hands upon myself, or at least ask another, and he should do this for me.

translations.lxx: Oh then that I might lay hands upon myself, or at least ask another, and he should do this for me.
translations.kjv: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
translations.ron: Totuşi împotriva sărmanului nu ridicam mâna mea, când striga către mine, în nenorocirea lui.
translations.grk: Εἰ γὰρ ὄφελον δυναίμην ἐμαυτὸν χειρώσασθαι, ἢ δεηθείς γε ἑτέρου, καὶ ποιήσει μοι τοῦτο.

verses.geez: ትፈልሕ፡ ከርሥየ፡ ወኢታረምም፡ ወበጽሐኒ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ተፅናሰ።
verses.translation: Yet I wept over every helpless man; I groaned when I saw a man in distress.

translations.lxx: Yet I wept over every helpless man; I groaned when I saw a man in distress.
translations.kjv: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?
translations.ron: N-am plâns oare şi eu împreună cu cel care-şi ducea viaţa greu? Sufletul meu n-avea milă de cel sărman?
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ παντὶ ἀδυνάτῳ ἔκλαυσα, ἐστέναξα ἰδὼν ἄνδρα ἐν ἀνάγκαις·

verses.geez: ወበእኩ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽብብ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያስተግኅሦ፡ ሊተ፡ ኃጣእኩ፡ ወቆምኩ፡ ማእከለ፡ ብዙኃን፡ ወአወዩ።
verses.translation: But I, when I waited for good things, behold, days of evils came the more upon me.

translations.lxx: But I, when I waited for good things, behold, days of evils came the more upon me.
translations.kjv: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
translations.ron: Mă aşteptam la fericire şi iată că a venit nenorocirea; aşteptam lumina şi a venit întunericul.
translations.grk: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπέχων ἀγαθοῖς, ἰδοὺ συνήντησάν μοι μᾶλλον ἡμέραι κακῶν.

verses.geez: ወኮንኩ፡ እኅዋሆሙ፡ ለጽግነት፡ ወቢጾን፡ ለአዕዋፍ።
verses.translation: My belly boiled, and would not cease: the days of poverty prevented me.

translations.lxx: My belly boiled, and would not cease: the days of poverty prevented me.
translations.kjv: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
translations.ron: Măruntaiele mele au fiert în clocote fără încetare; zile de jale grea mi-au sosit înainte.
translations.grk: Ἡ κοιλία μου ἐξέζεσε καὶ οὐ σιωπήσεται, προέφθασάν με ἡμέραι πτωχείας.

verses.geez: ወያዝኀዝኀኒ፡ በሕቁ፡ ማእስየ፡ ተቀሎኩ፡ ወተሐርፃ፡ አዕፅምትየ።
verses.translation: I went mourning without restraint: and I have stood and cried out in the assembly.

translations.lxx: I went mourning without restraint: and I have stood and cried out in the assembly.
translations.kjv: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.
translations.ron: Am umblat înnegrit la faţă, dar nu de soare; m-am ridicat în adunare şi am strigat.
translations.grk: Στένων πεπόρευμαι ἄνευ φιμοῦ, ἕστηκα δὲ ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ κεκραγώς.

verses.geez: ወመሰንቆ፡ ኮነኒ፡ ሕማምየ፡ ወኮነኒ፡ መዝሙረ፡ አንብዕየ።
verses.translation: I am become a brother of monsters, and a companion of ostriches.

translations.lxx: I am become a brother of monsters, and a companion of ostriches.
translations.kjv: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
translations.ron: Am ajuns frate cu şacalii, am ajuns tovarăş cu struţii.
translations.grk: Ἀδελφὸς γέγονα σειρήνων, ἑταῖρος δὲ στρουθῶν.
